titre: Practice test — English (4th year primary, first year) — Term 3

exercices.enonce:
Read and answer.

Hello! I am Yasmine. I have a rabbit. Its name is Coco. Coco is small and grey. I give Coco carrots every day. I love my rabbit very much.

1) What pet does Yasmine have? (2 points)
2) What is its name? (2 points)
3) What does Yasmine give Coco? (2 points)
